Standard: The characteristics for user oversight include the user interfaces required to interact with the system as necessary to accomplish flight. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the air system design documentation (e.g., software documentation, digital mockups) and verify that the required characteristics of predictability, observability, directability, and error handling have been accurately provisioned in the air system design. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Test the implementation in a high-fidelity simulation or prototype and verify that users can oversee the air system operation and accomplish oversight.
